stem: During September, 45 new businesses subscribed to Voltmarkt's Business Care, a monthly device-support plan for small offices. How should they enter September's logo churn rate?

options.text: Not at all, because they were not active at the start of September
In the denominator only, because they were active during September
In both parts, so that new sign-ups and cancellations balance out
In the numerator only, as a negative number that offsets the losses
